name: Multiscale Feature Orbit Extraction via Hyper-iso-surface Intersection
definition: A procedure to track feature orbits (e.g., curvature extrema) across scale by intersecting two hyper-iso-surfaces: one from a multiscale extension image (intensity) and one from an image of scaled differential descriptors (zero-crossings).
summary: Multiscale Feature Orbit Extraction via Hyper-iso-surface Intersection tracks feature trajectories across scale space by intersecting intensity and differential descriptor surfaces, differing from standard methods by operating in four dimensions to capture feature evolution.
